scenarios.heading: Enter in a species that already has a saved animal leaves every other species' saved animals listed

steps.text: one species with more than one animal already has one animal saved, and a second such species also already has one animal saved
a valid identifier is typed into the first species' form and Enter is pressed in that field
the first species' saved-animals table lists both its original animal and the new one
the second species' saved-animals table still lists only its own original animal, unchanged

scenarios.heading: Commodity details goes on to identification details whenever the notification holds a commodity line

steps.text: the user is on commodity details
they save valid counts for a commodity line
identification details is shown

scenarios.heading: A commodity with no specific identifier is asked for the two free-text answers

steps.text: the user is entering identification details for an animal on a commodity line
that line's commodity calls for none of the specific identifiers
"Identification details" and "Description" are asked for that animal, each optional and at most 58 characters
no typed identifier is asked for that animal

scenarios.heading: A commodity declaring its own identifiers is not asked for the two free-text answers

steps.text: the user is entering identification details for an animal on a commodity line
that line's commodity declares one of the specific identifiers
neither "Identification details" nor "Description" is asked for that animal

scenarios.heading: Reopening the notification shows a saved record's free-text answers again

steps.text: a commodity line with no identifier of its own has a saved record holding both Identification details and Description
the user reopens the notification at the identification details page
the saved-animals table shows both values for that record

scenarios.heading: A commodity with no identifier of its own is asked for identification details then description

steps.text: a commodity line whose commodity carries no identifier of its own (for example, ostriches)
the user views the identification details page
that line has an identification card asking for "Identification details" then "Description"

scenarios.heading: A record on a commodity with no identifier of its own, carrying neither free-text answer, leaves the task To do

steps.text: a notification holds an animal record on a commodity with no identifier of its own, carrying neither Identification details nor Description
the user opens Overview
the Identification details task reads "To do"

scenarios.heading: An over-length free-text fallback value blocks the save, and 58 characters saves

steps.text: a commodity line with no identifier of its own
the user types a value of more than 58 characters into Identification details or Description and tries to save
the save is blocked and the error summary and the field read "Identification details must be 58 characters or less" or "Description must be 58 characters or less", linking to and focusing that field
they replace it with a value of 58 characters and save
the record is saved with no error

scenarios.heading: A commodity with no identifier of its own has a saved-animals table of identification details and description

steps.text: a commodity line with no identifier of its own
the user saves a record for it
its saved-animals table is headed by the animal column, Identification details, Description and a Remove action

scenarios.heading: A notification with no commodity line carries on past the page

steps.text: the notification holds no commodity line
the identification details page is requested directly
commodity selection is shown instead, and the page itself is never rendered

scenarios.heading: The free-text fallback fields carry their names and no hint

steps.text: the user is entering identifier details for a commodity with no identifier of its own
they view the entry form

neither shows hint text

scenarios.heading: Filling Identification details alone saves the animal

the user fills in Identification details, leaves Description blank, and saves

scenarios.heading: Filling Description alone saves the animal

steps.text: a commodity line with no identifier of its own
the user fills in Description, leaves Identification details blank, and saves
the animal is saved

scenarios.heading: Choosing a commodity that declares no identifier of its own still reveals the row

steps.text: the user has chosen a commodity that carries no identifier of its own
a country of origin is saved

the second section lists Commodity details, then Identification details, then Additional details, in that order

scenarios.heading: A species that needs a permanent address has a saved-animals table of its own identifiers alone

steps.text: a species whose commodity and species pair needs a permanent address (for example, cats or ferrets)
the user saves a record for it

scenarios.heading: An animal's stored address survives another animal on its line being saved and then removed on Identification details

steps.text: an animal saved with a hand-entered permanent address, on a line with a second animal still outstanding

scenarios.heading: A line needing a permanent address with no animal counted has no permanent address row

scenarios.heading: Animals not all saved against the place of destination show the count of animals instead of an address

steps.text: every animal that needs a permanent address on the notification has one, and they are not all saved against the place of destination

steps.text: a save refused on the permanent address page

it has no serious or critical accessibility violation

scenarios.heading: A blank new address shows the six required messages on their own fields

steps.text: a card with "Enter a new address" chosen and every field left blank
the user saves

scenarios.heading: A malformed email, phone or postcode is saved as typed

Check a cat, a dog and a non-pet commodity each behave as stated, and check the stored shape the plan chose for the same-as-destination answer (c-239).

Identification details' browser tests read GOV.UK's green at run time and find the save buttons by role
Every selected species has an identification panel, and a species with no specific identifier is asked for identification details and a description
rows.gate: Check that a species with no specific identifier reads well on the page and on the saved-animals table: the two free-text answers are the pattern every later fallback commodity copies, so look at the panel's wording, the field order and the table headings before the rest of the catalogue arrives from MDM.
